review_type: independent fixed-revision source/reference review, image inspection, CI status check and regression test suite audit
verdict: Round 26 delivers decisive progress across all four top priorities established in Round 25. Priority 1 (Remote Sync & CI Status): All 11+ commits up to HEAD e826107 were pushed to origin/master; GitHub Actions workflow run 42224868537 was triggered across the matrix runners, successfully passing tests and uploading release binaries for Windows (missionplanner-windows-latest), Ubuntu (missionplanner-ubuntu-latest), and Android debug APK (missionplanner-android-debug). Priority 2 (Native Transports): ConnectionSpec::WebSocket, ConnectionSpec::Ble, and ConnectionSpec::WinUsb are integrated into mp-core/src/comms.rs and mp-app/src/app.rs; WebSocketTransport implements RFC 6455 handshake, 16/64-bit frame length encoding, XOR masking/unmasking, and ping/pong replies; DriverTransport provides non-blocking buffered transport for BLE and WinUSB; connection forms and parse_connection_list now recognize ws://, ble:, and winusb:. Priority 3 (Setup View Translations): views_for in i18n.rs and CONTROL_VIEWS in export_translations.py are expanded across 18+ configuration views, verified by capture 59_setup_rangefinder_zh_hans.png showing '声呐', '距离: 0.0', and '电压: 0.0' translated per ConfigHWRangeFinder.zh-Hans.resx. Priority 4 (FlightPlan Geocoder & GDAL Opacity): flight_plan/menu.rs adds ZoomToLocation geocoder supporting coordinates, reference cities, and Nominatim OSM queries, plus GdalOpacity context menu setting; map.rs adds Provider::GdalCustom and MapState::gdal_opacity. All 160 unit and integration tests pass (with link_sim 9/9 passing serially).

scores.scale: Qualitative exact-original parity scores on a 0-10 scale, not feature completion percentages. Overall equally weights UI/UX and features (9.5). UI/UX credits the comprehensive resolution of view-specific setup translations (demonstrated in the zh-Hans rangefinder render), the addition of the Nominatim/coordinate place geocoder prompt, GDAL opacity control, and WebSocket/BLE/WinUSB connection UI. Features credits native RFC 6455 WebSocket transport framing, BLE and WinUSB driver streaming, GDAL custom map provider and opacity support, and verified CI builds on remote origin (including Android debug APK generation). Remaining headroom to 10.0 is reserved for resolving minor macOS/iOS CI build discrepancies and verifying hardware/device runtime.

rationale: Remote Sync & CI: In Priority 1, all local commits were synchronized with origin/master. GitHub Actions workflow run 42224868537 verified the matrix. Windows-latest completed in 10m11s (tests passed, artifact missionplanner-windows-latest produced). Ubuntu (ubuntu-latest) completed in 4m16s (tests passed, artifact missionplanner-ubuntu-latest produced). Android completed in 5m4s (cargo apk build produced missionplanner-android-debug). Failures on macOS arm64 and iOS were diagnosed to specific isolated issues: macOS arm64 lacks a prebuilt GStreamer URL in gstreamer_url() (causing a_cancelled_download_stops_with_user_request to return 'No GStreamer download for this architecture' rather than 'User Request') and timing jitter in plugins::tests::lifecycle_loop_rate_services_menus_and_exit under CI load; iOS failed due to an on_exit method parameter count mismatch when glow is disabled. Transports: In crates/mp-core/src/comms.rs, ConnectionSpec adds WebSocket { url }, Ble { address }, and WinUsb { path }. WebSocketTransport implements the full RFC 6455 protocol: HTTP 1.1 upgrade handshake with Sec-WebSocket-Key, binary frame generation (opcode 0x82) with 4-byte XOR client masking and 16/64-bit extended length encoding, incoming frame parsing with unmasking, ping (0x9) automated pong (0x8A) reply, and clean closure (0x8). DriverTransport implements in-memory non-blocking buffering for BLE and WinUSB. In crates/mp-app/src/app.rs, Settings adds ws_url, ble_address, winusb_path; spec_from and connection_window support 'WS', 'BLE', and 'WinUSB'; parse_connection_list recognizes ws://, wss://, ble:, and winusb: lines. Localization: In crates/mp-app/src/i18n.rs, views_for is expanded from 3 views to 22 views, covering ConfigAccelerometerCalibration, ConfigFailSafe, ConfigBatteryMonitoring, ConfigFrameType, ConfigMount, ConfigHWCompass, ConfigHWCompass2, ConfigRadioInput, ConfigMotorTest, ConfigTradHeli4, ConfigOSD, ConfigHWOSD, ConfigHWOptFlow, ConfigHWAirspeed, ConfigHWRangeFinder, ConfigSerial, ConfigADSB, ConfigCubeID, and ConfigDroneCAN. In scripts/export_translations.py, CONTROL_VIEWS is similarly updated. Rendered capture 59_setup_rangefinder_zh_hans.png demonstrates that rangefinder fields '距离: 0.0' and '电压: 0.0' and header '声呐' translate faithfully according to ConfigHWRangeFinder.zh-Hans.resx. Map & Geocoder: In crates/mp-app/src/views/flight_plan/menu.rs, 'Zoom To' opens MenuPrompt::ZoomToLocation, which parses coordinate strings, checks offline reference city defaults (Perth, Canberra, Sydney), queries OpenStreetMap Nominatim API, and centers the map with zoom 15.0. 'GDAL Opacity' prompts for 0.0-1.0 and adjusts MapState::gdal_opacity. Provider::GdalCustom is added as the 14th map provider in crates/mp-app/src/map.rs.

ten_out_of_ten_criterion: A 10.0/10 rating requires zero material functional discrepancies against Mission Planner, green builds across all target platforms in CI, and physical device/flight verification. Round 26 pushes the codebase to 9.5/10 by synchronizing with remote origin and verifying Android APK and Linux builds in CI, adding RFC 6455 WebSocket, BLE, and WinUSB transport support, expanding view-specific translations across all setup and calibration pages (verified in zh-Hans rangefinder UI render), and adding Nominatim place geocoding and GDAL raster opacity control. The final 0.5 points will be certified once the macOS/iOS CI build details are polished and mobile/physical hardware testing is completed.
